title: From tools to thieves: Measuring and understanding public perceptions of AI through crowdsourced metaphors
reasoning: The paper identifies and evaluates 'God' (deity/divine creature) as one of its 20 dominant metaphors used to understand AI. It also heavily analyzes moral and ethical dimensions such as 'thief' (plagiarism/stealing), trust, and the social justice implications of anthropomorphizing AI for marginalized communities.
